results.title: Heirate mir!
results.overview: "Get on board" is the slogan used by a bus company to attract bachelors looking to get married. A few village simpletons, including the shy gravedigger Eugen, gladly accept the offer. And off they go to Poland to the marriage market. Eugen's acquisition is named Goschka. However, before the young Polish woman can enter into holy matrimony with him, she reveals to Eugen's overprotective mother that she is a wanted murderer of men. Shortly thereafter, Goschka takes a job as a cleaning lady at the crematorium. And finally, Eugen's friend even sells her to a brothel...

results.title: Sag mir nichts
results.overview: Lena is happily married. From the strange man in the S-Bahn but such a pull goes out that she gets involved in a spontaneous infidelity. The stranger, Martin, also thought that the marriage with his wife was completely safe. Nevertheless, what should actually be written off as an adventure between Lena and Martin is becoming the projection screen for newly created needs and longings. Lena and Martin can not let go of each other.

results.title: I like
results.overview: While more and more people share a large part of their lives on the internet, a particularly radical criminal is wreaking havoc in the tranquil town of Heide. He spies on his victims, kills them, and later posts photos of their corpses online. These macabre photos, visible to the whole world, are like trophies to the killer. Young martial artist Natascha teams up with young police officer Axel to track down the murderer.

results.title: President Mir Qanbar
results.overview: The film follows Mir Qanbar, an elderly Iranian man, as he campaigns in the country's presidential election.

results.title: Mah e Mir
results.overview: A modern poet Jamal who is against the traditional Urdu Poetry reads the biography of Mir Taqi Mir,one of the greatest poets of the 18th century. And sees Mir's reflection on his personality.

results.title: Fremd in mir
results.overview: Marked by retrograde amnesia, Liv knows neither who she is nor who she belongs to. To numb her emptiness, she alternately loses herself in the lives of Eva, Alba, and Jessica.

results.title: Isabel Allende: A Thousand and One Voices
results.original_title: Isabel Allende. Erzähl mir vom Leben
results.overview: A documentary about famous writer Isabel Allende.

results.title: Vertraue mir
results.overview: The young investment banker Elena Wagner is the star at the Ahrends & Oppermann bank in Frankfurt. She loves her job and subordinates everything else to it. She even ends her relationship with IT boss Marc for her work. Suddenly, however, she is excluded from meetings and her boss, Dr. Ahrends no longer wants to receive her. She only has a little time to get to the bottom of the matter with her ex-boyfriend Marc and save her own existence.

results.title: MIR
results.overview: A experienced exorcist, Malik , aims to complete his last case by capturing Mir, a grieving spirit bargaining to get his last wish fulfilled. t?

results.title: MIR
results.overview: In this work, I captured a fleeting moment from an ordinary day spent at a retreat with students, bringing forth a video space in extreme slow motion at 1/128 of real-time speed. This moment, which passes by without being perceived by the body, exists in the space between fantasy and reality.

results.title: A Friend of Mine
results.overview: An introverted insurance executive at a car rental service is annoyed by his hyperactive, garrulous coworker, but the two end up becoming friends.

results.title: Bleib bei mir
results.overview: After the surprising death of his singing and life partner Charles, eccentric pop star Harry Hansen has lost all drive. Only his neighbor, the widowed surgeon Nicolaus Roeder, cares for him. To finally pull Harry out of his depression, he urges him to hire the unemployed cook Rosa as a housekeeper.

results.title: Mission to Mir
results.overview: This film shows how far we have come since the cold-war days of the 50s and 60s. Back then the Russians were our "enemies". And to them the Americans were their "enemies" who couldn't be trusted. Somewhere in all this a young girl in Oklahoma named Shannon set her sights on becoming one of those space explorers, even though she was told "girls can't do that." But she did.

results.title: After Us, the Flood
results.overview: After a long time, young Franz returns to the village of his childhood, Klein-Reibach. The big anniversary celebration is coming up. But he is shocked to discover that his hometown is threatened by a crack in the old, dilapidated dam. In order to save the village, Franz has to stand up to the inhabitants, who don't want to know about the impending danger. A drama in three acts.

results.title: Mir Mortals
results.overview: First transmitted in 1998, this is the story of four men who orbited Earth on board the ill-fated Mir space station, which NASA declared unsafe in 1991. Although Mir had been lived in almost continuously since she was launched in 1986, the joint Russian-American mission in 1997 saw unprecedented problems on board the station; from fire, power blackouts and mechanical breakdowns to a dramatic midspace collision that left everyone on board scrambling for their lives.

results.title: The Boy Mir
results.overview: Following the international hit The Boy who Plays on the Buddhas of Bamiyan, The Boy Mir will cover not one year but ten. It will track the cheeky, enthusiastic Mir from a childish eight to a fully grown eighteen-year-old. Over those ten years, it will be a journey into early adulthood in one of the toughest places on earth; a journey that mirrors the current and vitally important story of Afghanistan.

results.title: Where do I go from here?
results.overview: Majd and Shahfaisal live together in a residential group for unaccompanied refugee minors in Germany. Here, in the protected environment of the group, for the first time after fleeing, they should be able to live a life true to who they really are: teenagers who are just developing a personality, have dreams and are looking for their place in society. But how is this supposed to work if they are not even part of this society due to their refugee status?

results.title: Peace To You All
results.overview: The journey of the photographer and the phenomenon of authenticity across the war-torn environment of Donbas with the aim of connecting the various actors of the conflict in their unusual and interesting stories. They are emotional micro-stories of people from both sides of the front line, which move the plot through the panorama of the country's tragedy, in which all defense mechanisms leading to the establishment of permanent peace fail. The trenches divide families, change destinies and bring depression and uncertainty.

results.title: Schenk mir dein Herz
results.overview: After a heart attack, a singer recovers in a sanatorium.
